questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Inventions and inventors vocabulary
questions.prompt: Which word means “the first person to make a new thing”?
questions.evidence: An inventor is the person. The thing the person makes is an invention.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Inventions and inventors vocabulary
questions.prompt: The telephone, the television and Wi-Fi are all ______.
questions.evidence: They are things that people made, so they are inventions. An inventor is the person who makes them.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Inventions and inventors vocabulary
questions.prompt: Bell wanted to talk to people without moving, and he ______.
questions.evidence: He wanted to do something and he did it, so he succeeded. Discover is for finding something that already exists.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Talking about the past and today
questions.prompt: In the past, life was ______ from today.
questions.evidence: The lesson contrasts life in the past with life today, so the two are different.

questions.prompt: The past simple of invent is ______.
questions.evidence: Invent is a regular verb, so the past simple adds -ed: invented.

questions.prompt: The past simple of try is ______.
questions.evidence: A verb ending in a consonant and y changes y to i before -ed: try → tried.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Irregular past simple verbs
questions.prompt: The past simple of fly is ______.
questions.evidence: Fly is irregular, so it does not take -ed: fly → flew.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Irregular past simple verbs
questions.prompt: The past simple of become is ______.
questions.evidence: Become is irregular: become → became. Becoming is not a past simple form.

questions.prompt: The past simple of carry is ______.
questions.evidence: Carry ends in a consonant and y, so y becomes i before -ed: carry → carried.

options: a) Did Bell invented the telephone?
c) Bell did invented the telephone.
questions.evidence: The past simple is either did + plain verb, or one verb in the past. It is never did + invented.

questions.prompt: ______ Marie Curie discover radium? — Yes, she did.
questions.evidence: The answer Yes, she did shows a past simple question, so the question opens with Did.

questions.prompt: They didn’t ______ the machine last year.
questions.evidence: After didn’t the verb goes back to its plain form: didn’t invent.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Reading a short text about an invention
questions.prompt: Read the text. Why did Karim plan his machine?
options: c) to sell it to his neighbours
questions.evidence: The text says he saw his grandmother carry heavy water and he wanted to help her.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Reading a short text about an invention
questions.prompt: In the text, Karim’s grandmother carried heavy water every morning.
questions.evidence: The text says Karim saw that his grandmother carried heavy water from the well every morning.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Reading a short text about an invention
questions.prompt: In the text, Karim’s first machine worked at once.
questions.evidence: The text says the first two machines broke, so the first machine did not work.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Reading a short text about an invention
questions.prompt: In the text, other families in the town use the same machine today.
questions.evidence: The text says today other families in the town have the same machine.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Writing sentences about inventors
questions.prompt: Make one complete sentence in the past simple with these words: karim / carry / the machine / to the well
questions.correct: Karim carried the machine to the well.
accepted: karim carried the machine to the well
questions.wrongSample: Karim carry the machine to the well.
questions.evidence: Carry becomes carried in the past simple, and the rest of the words keep their order.

questions.objectiveLabel: Lesson objective: Writing sentences about inventors
questions.prompt: Make one complete sentence in the past simple with these words: the machine / not / work / at first
questions.correct: The machine didn’t work at first.
accepted: the machine didn’t work at first
the machine didn't work at first
the machine did not work at first
questions.wrongSample: The machine not worked at first.
questions.evidence: A negative past simple sentence uses didn’t plus the plain verb, so it is didn’t work.
